episodes.title: The Comedian
episodes.summary: Samir Wassan is a desperate comedian who will do anything to get a laugh... and soon discovers that he has a power that will let him do exactly that.

episodes.title: Nightmare at 30,000 Feet
episodes.summary: Justin Sanderson boards Flight 1015 and finds an abandoned player that has a podcast on it of a future where the jet goes down without a trace. Can Justin stop the crash before it's too late?

episodes.title: Replay
episodes.summary: Nina Harrison is taking her son Dorian to college, filming the trip on her father's old camcorder. Nina discovers that the camcorder has the power to rewind time, but will it be enough for her to save Dorian?

episodes.title: A Traveler
episodes.summary: On Christmas Eve in the small Alaskan town of Iglaak, a mysterious man in a suit appears in a jail cell with no explanation and asks the chief of police for a pardon.

episodes.title: The Wunderkind
episodes.summary: After failing to help get his candidate reelected, campaign manager Raff Hanks comes out of a drunken retirement to help an 11-year-old become President. However, the results are not what Raff expected.

episodes.title: Six Degrees of Freedom
episodes.summary: The first manned space flight to Mars meets a few unexpected obstacles.

episodes.title: Not All Men
episodes.summary: After a meteor shower, the men in a nearby town start acting strangely... and violently.

episodes.title: Point of Origin
episodes.summary: The government takes away Eve, a suburban housewife, and claims that she harbors a dark secret but won't tell her what it is.

episodes.title: The Blue Scorpion
episodes.summary: When anthropology professor Jeffrey Strock's father kills himself with a legendary pistol, Jeff finds himself swept up in the legend... with lethal results.

episodes.title: Blurryman
episodes.summary: While working on the set of the new The Twilight Zone, writer Sophie Gelson is haunted by a mysterious Blurryman.

episodes.title: Meet in the Middle
episodes.summary: Lonely bachelor Phil finds meaningful human connection when he discovers a telepathic link to a stranger named Annie. Their connection quickly sparks a romance, but not everything is as it seems in this seemingly idyllic fantasy.

episodes.title: Downtime
episodes.summary: After a recent promotion to hotel manager, Michelle feels like she's on top of the world, but any cause for celebration is short lived when the nature of her reality is called into question.

episodes.title: The Who of You
episodes.summary: Struggling actor Harry risks everything to catch his big break, but an impulsive scheme takes a few turns no one saw coming.

episodes.title: Ovation
episodes.summary: The music career of struggling singer Jasmine takes off overnight after she witnesses a tragic incident. Jasmine begins receiving rapturous applause everywhere she goes, but she soon realizes the relentless recognition comes at a steep cost.

episodes.title: Among the Untrodden
episodes.summary: Transfer student Irene's unusual interests make her an easy target at her new all-girls boarding school until she discovers that popular classmate Madison possesses a unique talent.
At the outer reaches of the world, a team of scientists discover a new highly intelligent species, but its existence may endanger more than their research.

episodes.title: A Human Face
episodes.summary: A grieving couple's move is interrupted by an otherworldly encounter, leading them to second guess what's worth leaving behind.

episodes.title: A Small Town
episodes.summary: A quiet church handyman uncovers a magical scale model imbuing him with the power to help his struggling small town. But with the sleazy Mayor Conley taking all the credit, will Jason's good intentions be corrupted?

episodes.title: Try, Try
episodes.summary: When the quick-witted Claudia has a chance run-in with Mark at a museum, he dazzles her with his seemingly miraculous abilities. But after the true source of his charisma is revealed, the encounter takes a dark turn.

episodes.title: You Might Also Like
episodes.summary: Stay-at-home housewife Mrs. Warren looks forward to acquiring the widely marketed 'Egg,' an enigmatic device that promises to make everything better for everyone forever. But further investigation soon reveals the unsavory truth about this mysterious product.
